top_signals.title: Stocks Fall as US-Iran Turmoil Keeps Oil Elevated: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Stocks were under pressure while bond yields stayed elevated as an escalation in the conflict between the US and Iran kept fueling an advance in oil prices, leaving the prospect of interest-rate hikes this month in play.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
